title: Wire Rust SOS TX as dispatch 0x16
description: Implement the Rust lichen-node SOS sender path so the canonical SOS alert CBOR is wrapped with L2PayloadKind::Sos / dispatch 0x16 before link transmission. Add a focused independent test asserting dispatch and payload preservation.
close_reason: Implemented Stack::transmit_sos with authenticated L2 dispatch 0x16 and exact CBOR loopback coverage. Focused test and full lichen-node tests passed except pre-existing dao_origin_vectors failure (UnknownKey vs IidMismatch); clippy remains blocked by three unrelated existing diagnostics. Kimi K3 correctness/security/edge review attempts failed with insufficient OpenRouter credits, so all three reviews were completed locally with no findings.
